subject: PO backfill & itemization split for TideScale onboarding
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@tidescale.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Missing PO number / spend cap lower than expected - TideScale onboarding

Hi Rishi,

We completed the vendor onboarding form last week (attached) but our billing team shows no assigned PO number yet and the provisional spend ceiling is set to $20k — our finance team expected $75k for the first quarter. Also, the line items on the quoted invoice were combined under a single SKU; we need them split across two cost centers (ENG and DATA).

Can you help:
- Confirm if a PO has been issued or if you can backfill one retroactively?
- Raise the provisional spend cap to $75k or advise the approval path?
- Provide an itemized PO (or guidance on how to split line items) so our AP team can match invoices?

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf, invoice_preview.xlsx

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround, we go live early December.

Sanjay Rao
Head of Procurement, TideScale
procurement@tidescale.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@tidescale.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Missing PO number / spend cap lower than expected - TideScale onboarding

Hi Sanjay — thanks for flagging this. I pulled the onboarding packet and invoice. Short answers up front: we did not issue a final PO (provisional token only) and the provisional cap was set conservatively — we can start a backfill and a spend-cap exception request.

Plan / asks:
1) Monica, can you confirm approvals needed to move provisional cap from $20k -> $75k for new customers in the first 60 days?
2) Ben, can you open a vendor-activation ticket to backfill a formal PO and attach an itemized CSV so TideScale can map cost-centers?
3) Sanjay, can you share TideScale's vendor tax ID and the AP contact for cross-walk verification? If you prefer, I can push a provisional PO stub while approvals process.

I attached a short form (ponum_request_form.pdf) that will help speed the backfill. If we can get the tax ID and desired cost-center split, we should have a provisional PO to you within 24–48 hours.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Rishi / team — tagging in procurement ops. Quick summary of constraints and next steps from our side:

- Spend cap policy: increases > $50k require approval from Finance (FP&A) + Revenue Ops for new customers. I can submit the exception request but need the business justification and start/end dates for the increased ceiling.
- Line item split: AP prefers a two-row PO (ENG / DATA) with separate GL codes. Sanjay, please confirm the GL codes or we will default to the codes you provided in the onboarding packet.
- Backfill timing: We can issue a provisional PO (PO-PRV-20261113-TS.csv) to allow invoice matching immediately, but final PO issuance will be gated on approval.

I've attached a suggested split template (lineitem_split.csv) — Ben, please use this when creating the activation ticket.

Monica Patel
Procurement Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
